data.claim: Counterexample approach: (a) a writer appending a random UUID each time—neither idempotent nor safe under retry; (b) a writer appending a deterministic content hash—safe (duplicates detectable and removable) but still not idempotent; (c) a writer that checks the log for an existing entry before appending—idempotent in effect but introduces a read path contradicting append-only discipline. The log requires property (b): safety through deterministic identity.
